Looking for a CTO / Tech Lead

A startup producing short-form vertical video series for mobile platforms is looking for a CTO / Tech Lead to lead the technical side of the company.

Looking for someone who: - Is based in the US (mandatory, no relocation and/or visa support) - Has experience with video streaming, short-form video platforms, or similar media products - Knows how to build and scale strong engineering teams and platforms

This is a foundational leadership role with real influence on the product and company growth.

CV: elizaveta.brovko@ngrs.com
